title: fix(metadata): a stored package-less row the boot pass files under the host's package is one holder of an action name, not two, in the bare read's judgement
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBEDksiNafxfXRXpB1X2HVS)_ Fixes #32791 domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTb2uksUmXXyE2gwCp (card thread; claim 6832821089) Clause-②: no — the fix removes a refusal ADR-0150 D4 already denies ("A package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item. … it never arms beside the item it shadows (E1) and never makes the name ambiguous."). On a host that declares its package, `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` and `getDiagnosed` of a name one package's stored row holds beside a package-less stored row saved last go from `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming that package, the host's package and the environment to the package-less row, the answer before the bare read was judged over the loaders; beside a package's row bound to an object and an object-less package-less row saved last, from `409` naming the package and the host's package to the environment's own item; beside two packages' rows, the `409` names the two packages and the environment and no longer the host's package. Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is how many holders a read naming no package counts for one stored row. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：宿主声明了自己的包时，启动预载会把库里的无包行盖上宿主包戳放进宿主槽；不带包名按名读动作、要同时看 loader 时，这一行以前被算了两次（宿主包一次、环境一次），现在按 D4 的写入规则只算一次：一个包持有时是它的定制，否则是环境自己的项。 - 为什么改：#32560 合入后，这种组合下的裸读 409 多点名了一个并不存在的持有者 `com.host.app`（专题 #31527 红线 2：歧义要如实报告）；专题座位裁定是 #32560 的回归，发版前单独修。 - 风险与回滚：只动"不带包名的读"的裁判视图，且只针对存储型 loader（`datasource:`）交出的无包行；读具体包、其余八个按包类型、裸删除都不变。第一方组合里没有接数据库加载器的宿主，仓库里应答不变。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `slotViewOf`（`asStored` 分支）和 `loadMany` 里记录无包存储行的那三行；`package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `packagelessWriteKeyOf`（与写入规则共用 `packagelessSlotOf`）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32791`，应见 5 passed（main 的源码下 3 failed、2 个 CONTROL 通过）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes On a host that declares its package (`MetadataPlugin`'s `packageId`), the boot priming pass stamps every item it registers that carries no package with the host's package (`applyProtection`), a package-less `sys_metadata` row included, so the registry holds that row in the host's slot. Since #32560 (`070e8796`), a read naming no package of an action name a package holds in memory is judged over the registry's slots and the loaders' stored slots together (`judgesLoaderSlots`). The loaders still store that row package-less, so the one row was counted twice — as the host's package (its registry slot) and as the environment (the loader's slot) — and the refusal named `com.host.app`, a holder that does not exist. **The fix (`packages/metadata`, two source files).** 1. **`MetadataManager.loadMany` records the environment's stored rows.** An item of a type stored per `(package, name)` that a stored-row loader (`contract.protocol === 'datasource:'`, i.e. `DatabaseLoader`) hands out held for no package (`indexedItemPackageId(item) === undefined`, read before any caller stamps it) goes into a private `WeakSet` (`storedPackagelessRows`), beside the existing `loadedFrom` map. 2. **`slotViewOf(…, asStored)`**, asked with `asStored` only by `loadSlottedDiagnosed` for a read naming no package (so `get` and `getDiagnosed`): a registry slot of a package whose item is such a row, and whose stored key (`storeSlotKey(type, name, undefined, item)`) a loader still holds, is not added under the package's key, and the loader's copy at the stored key is not added either. The row is filed instead where the store files a write that carries no package, over the view (`packagelessWriteKeyOf`): the slot of the name's one package holder (D4: its customization, which shadows the holder's row), or else the identity's bare slot (the environment's own item). Every other slot — a package's own item, a host's own item no stored row is, a row whose loader no longer stores it — is kept as before. 3. **`packagelessWriteKeyOf` (`package-slotted-store.ts`, new export)** is the package-less branch of the store's write rule, now one internal helper (`packagelessSlotOf`) that `storeWriteKey` / `storeRowWriteKey` and the view share, so the rule stays in one place. `storeWriteKey`'s own answers are unchanged (the branch is the same expression, moved). Not changed: a read naming a package (the view is built as before, so a read naming the holder still answers the holder's own row); the registry's keys (the pass still files the row in the host's slot, and a read naming the host still answers it); every other by-package type (their bare read is answered by the registry alone, `judgesLoaderSlots` is `action` only); a removal naming no package (`removalOf` builds the view without `asStored`; see Acceptance notes). ### Moved answers (FROM → TO) FROM is `main` at `2f80f289` (after #32560; first measured at `ee230a25`, the same three answers). Rows of `helper` in `sys_metadata`, one `DatabaseLoader`, the real boot pass (`MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem`) on a host declaring `com.host.app`; "before #32560" is `296e2ec8` (`070e8796^`), measured with this PR's pin over that tree's `packages/metadata/src`. | # | Rows (version order) | Read | before #32560 | FROM (main) | TO (this PR) | Arm | |:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--| | 1 | ALPHA's row, then a package-less row (ALPHA's customization) | `get('action', 'helper')`, `getDiagnosed` | the package-less row | `409` `ambiguous-in-environment` naming ALPHA, `com.host.app`, environment | the package-less row (`degraded: false`) | a refusal D4 denies, removed | | 2 | ALPHA's row, BETA's row, then a package-less row | the same | the package-less row (a pick between two packages) | `409` naming ALPHA, BETA, `com.host.app`, environment | `409` naming ALPHA, BETA, environment | phantom candidate removed; #32560's refusal kept | | 3 | ALPHA's row bound to `account`, then an object-less package-less row | the same | the environment's own item | `409` naming ALPHA, `com.host.app` | the environment's own item | a refusal D4 denies, removed | Every other cell of the composition answers on `main` as here (CONTROLs below), so for the release this PR and #32560 ship in, rows 1 and 3 answer as the last release did, and row 2 is #32560's narrowing with its true candidates. ### Owed item 2: the other eight by-package types in the same composition Measured with an uncommitted probe over every unbundled member of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (`api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `permission`, `flow`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`), both save orders, hosts declaring no package, ALPHA, or `com.host.app`; reads naming none, ALPHA and the host; plus the two-holder and object-bound shapes above. On `main` and on this head the eight types other than `action` answer identically in every cell: the bare read answers the package-less row (stamped with the host's package where the host declares one) when it was saved last, ALPHA's row when ALPHA's was saved last; reads naming ALPHA or the host as before. **No answer of the eight types moves.** Of the probe's 83 rows, exactly the three `action` cells of the table above differ between `main` and this head. (The probe's rows that meant to add a file item named it `helper.json`, which no type's file patterns load, so those rows measure the stored rows alone; the host's own item is covered by the in-memory CONTROL below.) The committed CONTROL pins the bare read of all nine types in every cell but row 1's. ### Owed item 3: what #32676's C3 `action` cell tightens to after this lands #32676's `[#32521]` "CONTROL action, one package's row and a package-less row of the name (that holder's customization, D4)" asserts its `package-less row saved last` / `com.host.app` cell loosely by the epic seat's ruling. With this PR on `main`, that cell answers exactly what its `efd4ea3a` table row says, and the loose assertion can return to the table: `['package-less row saved last', HOST, ['env'], ['com.host.app\u0000helper'], 'env', ALPHA, 'env']` — registry key the host's slot, bare read `'env'`, read naming ALPHA `ALPHA`, read naming the host `'env'`. Measured on #32676's head merged with this branch: see Verification. That edit is #32676's, not this PR's. ## Tests `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#32791] a stored package-less row the boot pass files under the host's package is one holder of an action name, not two')`, placed before the `[#32458]` block (so #32676's appended block merges without a conflict). Real `MetadataPlugin` boot pass over a real `DatabaseLoader` on the file's in-memory driver: - rows 1, 2 and 3 above (row 1 also asserts `getDiagnosed`, the registry key, and the reads naming ALPHA and the host unchanged); - CONTROL: every by-package type, one package's row and a package-less row, both save orders, hosts declaring no package, ALPHA, or another — the bare read answers the row the pass registered (row 1's cell is the first case, so it is left out here; the length is asserted); - CONTROL: the host's own item registered in memory beside one package's stored row is still a holder — the bare read is refused naming both.
Red before the fix, and before #32560 - This head's tests over `main`'s (`2f80f289`, and before that `ee230a25`) `metadata-manager.ts` and `package-slotted-store.ts` (`git restore --source=` on the two files, restored with `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`, `git diff HEAD` empty): **3 failed** (rows 1–3) | 2 passed (both CONTROLs). - This head's test file over `296e2ec8`'s whole `packages/metadata/src` (before #32560): 1 failed (row 2, which answered `'env'`, the pick) | 4 passed — rows 1 and 3 answered as this head does. Restored the same way.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor hit 1, restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty) Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32791` (the test imports the package's `src`, no `dist/` leg). | Mutation | Result | |:--|:--| | `loadMany` no longer records the stored package-less row (`storedPackagelessRows.add` replaced by a marker) | 3 failed (rows 1–3), 2 passed | | the row filed at its stored key instead of by the write rule (`storeSlotKey(type, name, undefined, data)`) | 2 failed: row 1 (answers ALPHA's row, not its customization) and the every-type CONTROL (the host-ALPHA `action` cell answers ALPHA's row) | | `asStored` never passed (`false`) | 3 failed (rows 1–3) | | `asStored` passed for a read naming a package too (`true`) | 1 failed: row 1's "a read naming the holder, as before" (answers the customization, not ALPHA's row) |
## Acceptance notes - **Removal is not changed, and has the same double count (finding, for the seat to file).** `MetadataManager.unregister(type, 'helper')` naming no package, in row 1's composition, is refused `409` naming ALPHA and `com.host.app` for all nine by-package types (`action` also names the environment) — measured on `main`, and on `296e2ec8` (before #32560) for all nine without the environment. So it predates #32560 (`removalOf` has judged the same view since the loaders' slots joined the removal) and is not this card's regression. The read's filing cannot be reused as is: the removal maps the view's keys back to the registry's (`registryStore.has(key)`), and a row filed in its holder's slot would hide the package-less slot that an `action` removal beside one package must take (#32560's `packagelessOnly`). Dedupe words: bare removal, host package stamp, stored package-less row, phantom holder, `removalOf`. - The filing applies only to items a `datasource:` loader handed out for no package: a host's own item (code, files, the artifact door's `MemoryLoader`) that the pass stamps with the host's package is the host's, and stays a holder. A loader that no longer stores the row leaves the registry slot counted as before. - The filed row inherits no write order in the view (it sits under a key the registry does not hold), as a loader's item; no composition measured here reads "written last" across it. - First-party reach 0: no package, app or example wires a `DatabaseLoader` (`setDatabaseDriver` / `setDataEngine` have no caller outside `metadata-manager.ts`). - The branch is `claude/project-thread-vg59ca` (platform-assigned), not `claude/issue-32791-…`. - `pr_request_reviewers` is the seat's step at hand-off; this PR is created with `os-sales` as assignee only. ## Verification At head `003d6480` (`main` `2f80f289` merged into this card's commits): - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test` (under the verify lock): 76 files, **1966 passed** (1966); this PR adds 5 tests and changes none. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --listFiles` includes `database-loader.test.ts`). `npx eslint` on the three changed `.ts` files: exit 0 (re-run at this head). - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (4 paths vs merge base `2f80f289`): 64 derived, **64 exit 0**; `--ran` reconciliation: 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first answered exit 3 (prerequisite, no `dist/`), and exit 0 after a full `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (exit 0); `check:type-check-debt` ran under the lock. - #32676's C3 tightening, measured: #32676's head `4cc152e4` merged with `main` `ee230a25` and this branch at `a1a7b654` (a local scratch merge, never pushed; both merges clean), with that cell's loose assertion replaced by the exact table row above: `database-loader.test.ts` **260 passed** (260). The same edit on #32676's head merged with `main` alone: that cell fails (`-t` on it: 1 failed, 254 skipped). This head adds only `main` `2f80f289` over `a1a7b654`, which changes `metadata-manager.ts` only in `getPublished` (#32497), away from this PR's hunks. - Not run: the full dogfood battery (no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm); `pnpm lint` (CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` is the reading). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01L6bhgTb2uksUmXXyE2gwCp)_
